preconditions.description: The integer n must be between 1 and 100000.
The length of the permutation must be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation must be between 1 and n.
All elements in the permutation must be unique.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'ambiguous' if permutation == inverse_permutation else return_value == 'not ambiguous'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'ambiguous' if the permutation is the same as its inverse permutation, otherwise 'not ambiguous'.
